name: iron-browser-app
description: IronBrowser — Ultra-lean multi-viewport Zen Chromium developer browser

scripts.build:main: bun build src/main/index.ts --outdir dist/main --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.build:preload: bun build src/preload/shell-preload.ts src/preload/mirror-preload.ts src/preload/agent-preload.ts --outdir dist/preload --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.build:renderer: bun build src/renderer/shell.ts src/renderer/agent-dock.ts --outdir dist/renderer --target browser --format iife && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/styles.css src/renderer/welcome.html src/renderer/agent-dock.html src/renderer/agent-dock.css dist/renderer/
scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:main && bun run build:preload && bun run build:renderer
scripts.start: bun run build && sh -c 'if [ "${1:-}" = "--" ]; then shift; fi; has_ozone=0; for arg in "$@"; do case "$arg" in --ozone-platform*) has_ozone=1; break ;; esac; done; if [ "$has_ozone" -eq 1 ]; then exec electron . "$@"; elif [ -n "${DISPLAY:-}" ] || [ -n "${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-}" ]; then exec electron . --ozone-platform-hint=auto "$@"; else exec electron . --ozone-platform=headless --ozone-override-screen-size=1480,920 "$@"; fi' _
